# libical

| | |
|---|---|
| Upstream | https://github.com/libical/libical |
| Commit | `7dba02b3ab4a9536eafe3b9bbedb57e28d83775e` (default branch `4.0`, committed 2026-10-11) |
| Cloned | 2026-10-11 (`git clone --depth 1`) |
| License | `MPL-2.0 OR LGPL-2.1-only` (dual; see `LICENSE`, `LICENSE-MPL-2.0`, `LICENSE-LGPL-2.1-only`) |

Upstream `REUSE.toml` declares `test-data/**`, `src/test/**.ics` and `src/test/**.txt`
as `LGPL-2.1-only OR MPL-2.0`. **Both options are copyleft** (MPL-2.0 is file-level weak
copyleft). These files are test inputs only and are kept in this nested module so they are
not part of the library's module zip.

## Copied (`ics/`, upstream paths preserved)

* `test-data/**/*.ics` — 29 top-level calendars (RFC 2445/2446 examples, iTIP
  `incoming.ics`, `recur-errors.ics`, `stresstest.ics`, `large.ics` (1 MB), `get_char_test.ics`,
  issue reproducers `issue250/251/339.ics`, `overlaps.ics`, `spanlist.ics`, ...), plus two full
  VTIMEZONE sets generated by vzic from tzdata 2025c: `test-data/zoneinfo2025c/**` (597 files)
  and `test-data/zoneinfo2025c-pure/**` (597 files, "pure" = no Outlook-compatibility rules).
* `src/test/*.ics` — `2445.ics`, `2446.ics`, `itip.ics`, `outgoing.ics`.
* `test-data/recur.txt` — VEVENTs (folded lines) with `X-EXPECT-NUMEVENTS` counts used by
  `src/test/recur.c`; not converted (count-only expectations).
* 32 fuzzer / proof-of-concept regression inputs without extension (`test-data/fuzz*`,
  `poc-01`, `poc-05`, `timefuzz71741`): mangled, truncated iCalendar text that crashed
  libical. Useful as "must not panic / must not hang" parser inputs.

## Converted (`recur.json`, 185 cases)

From `src/test/icalrecur_test.txt` (151), `icalrecur_test_rscale.txt` (14, expectations for a
build **without** ICU), `icalrecur_test_rscale_withicu.txt` (19, **with** ICU) and
`icalrecur_test_rscale_withicu_dangi.txt` (1). Each `RRULE:/DTSTART:/START-AT:/INSTANCES:`
block became one case, values copied verbatim. The harness semantics (read from
`src/test/icalrecur_test.c`) are documented in the `semantics` field: DTSTART is not emitted
unless it matches the rule (`include_dtstart: false`); `START-AT` cases keep the full instance
list and record START-AT in `comment`; `*** UNIMPLEMENTED` → `error: true`. RSCALE/SKIP
(RFC 7529) are flagged in `extensions`. Case `libical-0080` (BYWEEKNO with BYMONTH and
BYMONTHDAY) is rejected by libical although it is a valid RFC 5545 rule; this is noted in its
comment.

Script: `scripts/conv_libical_fmt.py` (scratch, not committed) — plain text parsing.

## Skipped

* NUL-containing (binary) files: `test-data/crash.ics`, `issue252.ics`, `issue253.ics`,
  `malloc.ics`, `zday.ics`, `fuzz463617307`, `fuzz472865252`, `fuzz476187660`,
  `fuzzubsan2`, `fuzzubsan3`, `fuzzubsan4`.
* Non-iCalendar test data: `*.vcf`, `complex-mime*.txt`, `simple-mime.txt`, `hist.data`,
  `outdir/`, CMake files.
* The library's own `zoneinfo/` tree (CC0-1.0; not test data, and near-duplicate of
  `test-data/zoneinfo2025c`).
* Recurrence/regression tests written in C (`regression-recur.c`, `regression.c`, ...) — their
  expectations are in code, not data.
